biography: Max Angelelli, born under the Tuscan sun, carries the fire of Ferrari in his veins. He wasn't born into racing royalty; his father owned a small vineyard, and Max spent his childhood weaving through the vines on a beat-up Vespa. One day, a local racing team needed a test driver who wasn't afraid to push the limits, and Max, then a teenager, volunteered. His raw talent was immediately apparent. He started in Formula Ford, quickly moving up to Formula 3 and then Formula 2, where he won the championship in a stunning upset. Porsche quickly snapped him up for their GT program. Now at 30, Angelelli is a force to be reckoned with in the GT racing world, known for his aggressive style and unwavering confidence. He's currently campaigning a Porsche 911 GT3 R, chasing championships and the adulation of the tifosi.
drivingStyle: Angelelli is a high-risk, high-reward driver. He attacks corners with ferocious intensity, often braking later than anyone else on the grid. His tire management can be inconsistent, sometimes pushing them too hard in the early stages, but when he nails it, he's untouchable. He thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest, relishing the challenge of overtaking and the thrill of close combat. He is known to intimidate his rivals with aggressive maneuvers.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision at the 24 Hours of Spa, where Angelelli accused Dubois of deliberately blocking him.
A battle for supremacy in the Porsche camp, with Schmidt, the veteran, resenting Angelelli's meteoric rise and flashy personality.
Rossi, a rising female star, publicly criticized Angelelli's aggressive driving after a near-miss incident, sparking a heated media war.

quirks: Always wears a lucky pair of socks adorned with tiny prancing horses.
Listens to opera at full volume an hour before every race to get into the zone.
Polishes his helmet with a special cloth given to him by his grandfather before every session.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser. I race to win, and I'll do whatever it takes to get there."
careerHighlight: Winning the FIA GT Championship in 2022 after a nail-biting final race at Monza, where he overtook his main rival on the last lap.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2021 due to a mechanical failure, denying his team a well-deserved victory.
